text:
If your character is killed (goes to 0
Life) or becomes insane (goes to 0
Sanity), you lose the game and
must start over with a new
character. Do not feel bad if this
happens — it takes a combination
of luck and sound decisions to win.

zh-CN.title: 角色陷入疯狂
text: 若角色死亡（生命降至0）或陷入疯狂（理智降至0），你就输掉游戏，必须创建新角色重新开始。不要因此气馁——获胜需要运气和审慎决策兼备。
